scenario.title: Woo Analytics Products Stats: 1,000,000 Lookup Rows
scenario.trigger: Product stats REST endpoint over 1,000,000 product lookup rows with cache refresh forced.

slow_queries.sql: SELECT SUM(product_qty) as items_sold, SUM(product_net_revenue) AS net_revenue, COUNT( DISTINCT ( CASE WHEN product_gross_revenue >= 0 THEN wp_wc_order_product_lookup.order_id END ) ) as orders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as products_count, COUNT(DISTINCT variation_id) as variations_count FROM wp_wc_order_product_lookup JOIN wp_wc_order_stats ON wp_wc_order_product_lookup.order_id = wp_wc_order_stats.order_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( wp_wc_order_stats.status NOT IN ( 'wc-auto-draft','wc-trash','wc-pending','wc-failed','wc-cancelled','wc-checkout-draft' ) ) AND wp_wc_order_product_lookup.`date_created` <= '2026-07-01 23:59:59' AND wp_wc_order_product_lookup.`date_created` >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wp_wc_order_product_lookup.`date_created`, '%Y-%m') AS time_interval FROM wp_wc_order_product_lookup JOIN wp_wc_order_stats ON wp_wc_order_product_lookup.order_id = wp_wc_order_stats.order_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( wp_wc_order_stats.status NOT IN ( 'wc-auto-draft','wc-trash','wc-pending','wc-failed','wc-cancelled','wc-checkout-draft' ) ) AND wp_wc_order_product_lookup.`date_created` <= '2026-07-01 23:59:59' AND wp_wc_order_product_lookup.`date_created` >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY time_interval
